title: First Steps: Lorenz Attractor
description: Section 9.7 Lorenz chaotic attractor patch with x/y/z output channels and projection-ready display.

walkthrough.title: Initialize the chaotic state
walkthrough.text: P7 sets the small nonzero x initial condition while y and z start at zero. The three integrators carry -x, -y, and -z to match the booklet equations.

walkthrough.title: Patch the x and z equations
walkthrough.text: P1 through a x10 input implements 1.8y in the x equation. MUL1 forms x*y from the two negative state variables; P2 and P3 then drive the -z integrator.

walkthrough.title: Patch s and r for the y equation
walkthrough.text: P4 and SUM1 form s = -(1 - 2.68z). MUL2 computes r = -x*s. P5 and P6 then provide the weighted terms for the -y integrator.

walkthrough.title: Display projections
walkthrough.text: OUT X, OUT Y, and OUT Z expose x, y, and z. Use X/Y for the top view, Z/X for the front view, or Z/Y for the side view.
